# Careers at Ethos

Ethos matches people to opportunities with AI.

From AI search, warm outreach, expert interviews to actionable insights, we have automated the process of accessing human intelligence end-to-end.

Leading organizations - investment funds, Fortune 500 enterprises, and frontier AI labs - partner with Ethos to source expertise in hours instead of weeks, powering critical decisions in due diligence, market research, and AI development.

For professionals, Ethos is a single profile that unlocks infinite opportunities. Our AI maps your unique expertise across the economy, connecting you to paid consultations, advisory roles, and full-time positions that match your knowledge - all automatically.

We leverage cutting-edge AI to fulfil our mission: to advance economic opportunities for all.
